messages:
Anya Rao: Pushing a new playground mock for quick review. Highlights: selectable streaming text, stop/try-again wording, token counter placement (overlay vs inline), and prompt library behavior when a suggestion is clicked mid-stream. Figma: https://figma.redwood/playground-v5 Miguel Santos: Nice iteration. Question: token counter realtime vs snapshot? Realtime is helpful but should be visually subtle to avoid attention capture. Anya Rao: Realtime but muted and fixed-position so no layout jumps. Shilpa Patel: A11y checklist: stop and try-again buttons must be keyboard accessible, have aria-labels, and expose state. Streaming region should not force screen reader focus changes. Dave Kim: Microcopy: switch secondary action to "Try again" instead of "Regenerate". Also tooltip: "Stop generation (partial output preserved)" Olivia Chen: Add offscreen hint for screen readers on stop: "Stops generation; keeps partial text". Recommend Esc as keyboard shortcut and include it in tooltip. Priya Nair: UX note: partial streamed text must remain selectable. Avoid pointer-blocking overlays. Also prefer an overlay token badge in bottom-right that ignores pointer events. Miguel Santos: Prototype snippet I used: ```
...
~123 tokens ``` Shilpa Patel: role="region" + aria-live polite is OK; test with NVDA/VoiceOver. Use aria-hidden on the token badge for screen readers if it doesn't add value. ui-bot: Uploaded preview w/ token overlay and confirm flow: https://staging.redwood/playground/v5-preview Dave Kim: Visual: add subtle trailing shimmer on the last token to indicate live typing. Provide a motion preference toggle in settings. Olivia Chen: I'll run color contrast and keyboard flows tomorrow and post results. Priya, can you test selection behavior when overlay present? Priya Nair: Yep I'll test selection and queuing. UX decision: clicking a prompt while streaming should surface a small confirm: "Replace current prompt and run?" Options: Replace & Run / Queue / Cancel. Miguel Santos: Add an undo toast when replacing: "Replaced prompt — Undo" for 4s. Shilpa Patel: Ensure toast is focusable and announced. Use role="status" and visible Undo link. Anya Rao: Action items: Shilpa -> a11y tests for aria roles and toast announcements; Miguel -> build token overlay prototype & undo toast; Olivia -> keyboard accessibility & contrast; Dave -> shimmer + motion toggle mock; Priya -> selection and confirm flow tests. We'll reconvene after test results. :thumbsup:
